bootstrap.interval: paired scan-mean percentile bootstrap, conditional on frozen cohort
bootstrap.limitations: Does not model dependence shared across separate scans/recordings

candidate_bank_scope: Available fractional-complete archived candidates, retaining their integer seeds. The public archive discarded integer seeds of fractional-incomplete candidates; this is not every originally acquired seed, and no margin gate is added.
cfo_shift_policy: Absolute physical total CFO difference; no symbol-rate wrapping

lower.interpretation: Descriptive subgroup, not an independent method-selection stage

upper.interpretation: Descriptive subgroup, not an independent method-selection stage

10000000.interpretation: Descriptive subgroup, not an independent method-selection stage

2500000.interpretation: Descriptive subgroup, not an independent method-selection stage

interpretation: Margin signs, candidate agreement, and CFO shifts are evidence comparisons; they do not estimate detection recall, RF false alarms, or position accuracy. Raw scores from different common-reference formulas are not directly comparable.
primary_case_rule: Both references present for all six primary methods
scope: Descriptive fixed later-window confirmation on an unlabeled scan cohort
